comments.body_normalized:
The recipes are stored differently while loading the mods and when the game runs; maybe this has something to do with the problem.
The initHashes function is called after loading the mods: http://github.com/minetest/minetest/blob/39c54e13c3ee3558f330f4d5716d8073b48de11a/src/server.cpp#L376
This function moves the recipes around that they can be found more efficiently: http://github.com/minetest/minetest/blob/39c54e13c3ee3558f330f4d5716d8073b48de11a/src/craftdef.cpp#L1090-L1105
When executing get_craft_result, the recipes are traversed: http://github.com/minetest/minetest/blob/39c54e13c3ee3558f330f4d5716d8073b48de11a/src/craftdef.cpp#L893

pull_request.body_normalized:
Fixes #8607

`getCraftResult` was not working before the `initHashes` call because it uses the recipe priority which was not initialized until the hashes are inited.

## To do

This PR is Ready for Review.

## How to test

- Start a world in the minimal game, there should be no assertion failure
- In MTG, try placing a wooden stair or slab in the fuel slot of a furnace
